edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender().
Constructor assigns the caller of _msgSender() into _owner.
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the sender argument to _transfer().
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance deduction.
setFeeTotal credits the caller derived from _msgSender() with freshly minted tokens.
onlyOwner compares _owner against _msgSender().
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable as the authorization source.
onlyOwner gates execution of setUniswapPair.
onlyOwner gates execution of setBlackAddress.
onlyOwner gates the privileged mint in setFeeTotal.
onlyOwner gates execution of setMaxWallet.
onlyOwner gates execution of renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership.
newUniswaPair argument is consumed by setUniswapPair.
setUniswapPair writes the attacker-adjacent _tUniswapPair address.
blackAddress argument is consumed by setBlackAddress.
setBlackAddress writes _tBlackAddress.
_maxWalletPercent argument is consumed by setMaxWallet.
setMaxWallet writes _maxWallet.
amount argument feeds the unchecked mint amount in setFeeTotal.
setFeeTotal triggers the privileged unbounded mint operation.
Mint increases _tTotal by an owner-chosen amount.
Mint credits the caller balance inside _balances.

amount argument is consumed by approve.

normalization_plan.reason: The spender parameter only carries the caller-supplied value into approve and has no standalone semantics.
The amount parameter only carries the allowance value into approve.
newUniswaPair is a direct argument of the setUniswapPair setter.
blackAddress is a direct argument of the setBlackAddress setter.
sender is directly consumed by transferFrom before delegating to _transfer.
recipient is directly consumed by transferFrom before delegating to _transfer.
amount is directly consumed by transferFrom for both transfer and allowance deduction.
amount directly feeds the unbounded mint inside setFeeTotal.
_maxWalletPercent is the sole argument written to _maxWallet by setMaxWallet.
recipient is directly consumed by transfer before delegating to _transfer.
amount is directly consumed by transfer before delegating to _transfer.
sender is directly consumed by _transfer for the balance debit.
recipient is directly consumed by _transfer for the balance credit and pair check.
amount is directly consumed by _transfer for the SafeMath balance update.
newOwner is directly assigned into _owner by transferOwnership.
owner is only a lookup key used by the allowance view function.
spender is only a lookup key used by the allowance view function.
account is only a lookup key used by the balanceOf view function.
